questions.explanation: Visit each valid list index once.

questions.question:
What is a.get(0) afterward if a contains [2, 3]?
for (Integer x : a) x++;
questions.explanation: Assigning a new boxed value to the loop variable does not replace a list element.

questions.question:
What is a.get(0) afterward if a contains [2, 3]?
for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) a.set(i, a.get(i) + 1);
questions.explanation: set replaces the value at each list position.
Backward traversal safely removes both matching entries without skipping shifted elements.
